about: What each provider's app can be asked for when Switchboard starts it for a person: the words its own model option takes, the efforts it takes, and how each is given on its command line. Every entry says where it was read and on which day. A model's line is the maker's own, from the maker's own list of its models.

models.name: Haiku
models.says: fast and efficient Haiku model for simple tasks
models.source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config (the table of model aliases: the words claude --model takes)

models.name: Fable
models.says: For demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work
models.source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview (the Description row, for Fable 5.2); the alias fable is in the table of model aliases at https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config, and Fable 5.2 needs Claude Code 2.1.321 or newer

efforts.source: claude --help, Claude Code 2.1.309: --effort <level> (low, medium, high, xhigh, max); https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config: the levels depend on the model

model.source: claude --help, Claude Code 2.1.309: --model <model>, Model for the current session (an alias such as fable, opus or sonnet, or a model's full name)

effort.source: claude --help, Claude Code 2.1.309: --effort <level>, Effort level for the current session
